Tridentu 2 Linux

A Linux distro made from scratch for the desktop - all while looking good doing it.

Just Effective
Tridentu 2 provides a simple desktop/terminal setup for those who want something that works and that feels famiiar.
Semi-minimal
Anything that's optional (meaning not needed for Tridentu to be Tridentu) is packaged using Caravel - Tridentu's own package manager/format.
Beautiful
Tridentu comes with beautiful, Nord-themed visuals - visuals that usually feel natural for the distro.

Not convinced?

Check out the features for more on this OS.
